about_the_game:
In Wok This Way, you step into the shoes of a rookie restaurant owner, bringing the flavors of traditional and modern Chinese cuisine to your community. From cooking delicious dishes, crafting custom menus, designing your restaurant, hiring the right staff, and providing top-tier service, every detail counts if you want to become the ultimate restaurateur!

Or, if you’re looking for a more relaxed experience, you can settle into your favorite city and immerse yourself in the stories of those around you.

🍳 Features You’ll Love:

✅ Restaurant Management – Handle everything from ingredient prep to cooking and serving!

✅ Employee System – Every staff member has distinct personalities and skills, making hiring and training a key strategy.

✅ Customize Your Restaurant – Design a space that fits your vision and keeps customers coming back for more!

✅ Dynamic Events – Surprise health inspections? Holiday rushes? VIP customer requests? Adapt your strategy to stay ahead!

✅ Create Your Own Menu – what is your restaurant specialize? Dim Sum? Sichuan spice? You are the Boss! It’s your call!

✅ Create Your Own Avatar – Customize your in-game character!

✅ Annual Restaurant Ratings – Your performance impacts your future—do you have what it takes to be the best?
